TestCompactStorage::test_read_old_format.description: Single node; creates ks.tb (key1,key2,val blob) WITH COMPACT STORAGE, stops node, copies pre-generated Scylla 'ka' sstables (test_data/scylla_compact_storage_wide_partition_old_format, one ~1000-row wide partition with deletions, written by pre-2.1 Scylla with the old/incorrect non-compound promoted index & range tombstone encoding) into the table dir, restarts, and asserts a full scan returns 800 rows. Guards backward-compat reading of old Scylla-written compact-storage sstables after the non-compound serialization fixes (scylladb/scylladb#2986, #2992, #2993).

TestCompactStorage::test_read_old_format.reason: Old-format compat for non-compound schemas is covered at unit level by boost sstable_datafile_test (test_old_format_non_compound_range_tombstone_is_read, test_broken_promoted_index_is_skipped, from scylla bd1efbc25c), but on a 3-row partition; the dtest adds an end-to-end boot-time load of a real wide partition. TestCompactStorage::test_wide_row.description: Single node; creates COMPACT STORAGE table (key1,key2,val blob), inserts one partition of 1000 rows x 10KB blobs (~10MB), flushes, deletes every 10th row (100 deletes), asserts 900 rows, flushes, restarts, asserts 900 rows again. Exercises writing/reading a wide non-compound (single clustering column) partition with promoted index and row tombstones.
